create_graph_with_nodes_and_arcs: create a gtn Graph with start and accept nodes connected by labeled arcs with weights
test_graph_weight_access: test getting and setting graph arc weights as lists, numpy arrays, or raw pointers
run_autograd_backward_pass: run backward propagation on a graph operation result to compute gradients on input graphs
test_parallel_graph_operations: test batched graph operations like add and negate across lists of graphs in parallel
save_and_load_graphs: save a gtn Graph to disk in binary or text format and load it back for comparison
